name: kncsv
description: Cổng thông tin Quản lý & Kết nối Cựu sinh viên - Khoa CNTT ĐH Đà Lạt
author: ThanhTriMKT <thanhtri.dev.pg@gmail.com>

scripts.install:all: uv sync --project backend && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.check:all: uv sync --project backend && uv run --project backend ruff check && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "backend\.venv\Scripts\uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir backend --app-dir backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev1: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "python -m uv run --project backend uvicorn --app-dir backend app.main:app --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
